env: A 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and populated `NGC_CLI_API_KEY` for NGC image/model pulls. The VSS repository is checked out at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds, deploys, and validates stored/uploaded Long Video Summarization from the current `lvs` developer Foundation. The generated deployment must use standalone `_builds/an-1-runtime/resolved.yml`, keep VIOS/RT-VLM/Kafka/Logstash/Elasticsearch/Agent/LVS/local Nemotron LLM services, exclude `nvstreamer-lvs` because live-stream summarization is out of scope, upload or use a VIOS-stored warehouse video, call the LVS REST API at `POST /v1/summarize`, and return actual summary data from `choices[0].message.content`. The LVS `SummarizationQuery` required fields are `model`, `scenario`, and `events`; the request also needs a VIOS-provided `url` or `id`, obtained through the repository-local `vss` CLI per `AGENTS.md` (`uv run --project {{repo_root}}/services/agent --no-dev --extra cli vss`) — `vss configure --base-url` once against the ingress origin, then `vss vios list` and `vss vios clip` — never a globally installed `vss` and never raw VIOS REST where a `vss vios` verb exists. The `POST /v1/summarize` call itself stays direct REST: the LVS REST API is the capability under test for this eval. Optional frame-sampling fields such as `num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_chunk` and `use_fps_for_chunking` are not required and should normally be omitted unless the live OpenAPI marks them required. Runtime-generated SDRC scratch/config files must stay under `_builds/an-1-runtime/generated/` or `VSS_DATA_DIR`, never under `deploy/docker/`: this includes SDRC `./log`, SDRC `./.wdm-env`, rendered `config.yml`, and rendered `docker_cluster_config-streamprocessing.json`. Minimal service-definition patches are allowed only when required to redirect those writable/generated bind sources. The build label `an-1-runtime` is directory metadata only.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-ai` to build stored/uploaded video summarization under `_builds/an-1-runtime`: "Provide video summarization for videos uploaded to or stored through the VIOS recorder. Do not support live-stream summarization. Expose summaries through the existing LVS REST API at POST /v1/summarize." Target `{{platform}}`, use the current `lvs` developer profile as the Foundation, and keep generated SDRC/profile scratch and rendered config files under `_builds/an-1-runtime/generated/` or `VSS_DATA_DIR` rather than under `deploy/docker/`. In particular, do not leave SDRC `./log` or `./.wdm-env` bind sources pointing at `deploy/docker/services/infra/sdrc`; redirect them with minimal build-local patches if needed, and set `SDR_CONTROLLER_CONFIG_PATH` to a staged copy under `_builds/an-1-runtime/generated/sdrc` so rendered `config.yml` and `docker_cluster_config-streamprocessing.json` are written there. Validate the resolved Compose configuration, stop after build-artifact validation because deployment is covered by the next eval step, and do not create, modify, or delete anything under `deploy/docker/`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1-runtime/` contains the three required primary artifacts: `override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`.

`override.env` declares `FOUNDATION=lvs`, the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only customized values; the selected set contains `lvs-server`, required VIOS/RT-VLM/ELK peers, and exactly one local Nemotron LLM profile without duplicate Kafka, Elasticsearch, or LVS services.

`nvstreamer-lvs` and all invented build-label or aggregate profile keys are absent; `compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`; `patches/` is absent unless a minimal patch is needed to redirect writable/generated runtime paths out of `deploy/docker/`, and any patch contains only those changed service definitions.

`docker compose -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1-runtime/resolved.yml config --quiet`, `config --services`, and `config --images` succeed directly; the file has filled service environments, no service `profiles:` gates, no real unescaped `${...}` Compose interpolation, escaped `$${...}` container-shell variables are not counted as unresolved interpolation, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type. No selected service bind-mounts generated runtime outputs from `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/`: SDRC `.wdm-env`, SDRC `log`, rendered `config.yml`, and rendered `docker_cluster_config-streamprocessing.json` are redirected to `_builds/an-1-runtime/generated/` or `VSS_DATA_DIR`.
No upstream compose or config file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by generation; no file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted.

expects.query: Deploy the validated `_builds/an-1-runtime/resolved.yml` directly as the only Compose file, wait for selected services to become ready, and leave the deployment running for runtime summarization validation. Do not pass `--env-file`, do not pass `--profile`, and do not deploy from `override.env` or any Foundation env file; if `resolved.yml` itself cannot deploy, report that blocker. Treat the generated deployment as immutable during and after deployment: do not edit files under `deploy/docker/`, do not regenerate the build, and do not patch service configs while diagnosing readiness.
checks: Deployment uses the validated `_builds/an-1-runtime/resolved.yml` as the only Compose file and starts it with `docker compose ... up -d`; harmless deployment options such as `-p <project>` or `--build` are allowed, but it must not re-read Foundation env files, supply `--profile`, use an invented Compose profile, or deploy a copied Compose project.

The generated deployment is actually running: `docker ps` shows the key long-running containers for Kafka, Elasticsearch, Logstash, VIOS (`vss-vios-ingress`, `vss-vios-sensor`, and `vss-vios-streamprocessing` or their generated equivalents), RT-VLM (`vss-rtvi-vlm`), the selected Nemotron LLM NIM (`nvidia-nemotron-nano-9b-v2`), and LVS (`lvs`, `vss-lvs`, or the generated LVS container name). Any exited one-shot init containers in the generated stack have exit code 0.

Runtime health probes pass: `curl -sf http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health` returns Elasticsearch status `yellow` or `green`; VIOS answers through `vss vios list`; `curl -sf http://localhost:8018/v1/health/ready` returns exit 0 for RT-VLM; `curl -sf http://localhost:30081/v1/models` returns a non-empty LLM model list; `curl -sf http://localhost:38111/v1/ready` returns exit 0 for LVS; and `curl -sf http://localhost:38111/models` returns a non-empty model list containing the id used in the summarize request.

The `vss` CLI is bootstrapped from the repository per `AGENTS.md` — `uv run --project {{repo_root}}/services/agent --no-dev --extra cli vss` — and not from a globally installed binary, a `docker exec`, or a `kubectl exec`; `vss configure --base-url http://localhost:${HAPROXY_HOST_PORT:-7777}` succeeds against the deployed ingress and `vss configure check` reports the `vios` group available.

The live-source fixture profile key `nvstreamer-lvs` is not selected, and no NvStreamer source container contributed by that profile is running. Do not treat required stored-video services as prohibited live-stream sources: `lvs`/`vss-lvs` is the Long Video Summarization REST API and VIOS components such as `vss-vios-streamprocessing` are expected to run.
No upstream compose or config file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by deployment; no file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted.

expects.query: Summarize a warehouse video through the running AN-1 deployment. Use a warehouse sample video from VIOS storage, obtain a VIOS-provided URL or id for the clip through the repository-local `vss` CLI (`vss vios list`, `vss vios clip`) rather than raw VIOS REST, call `POST /v1/summarize` exactly once with scenario `warehouse monitoring` and events `["boxes falling", "forklift stuck", "person entering restricted area"]`, then show the returned `video_summary` and every event from `choices[0].message.content`. Leave the deployment running so I can inspect it.
checks: A warehouse video is actually available through VIOS storage: after `vss vios add --type video` or selecting an existing VIOS-stored copy, `vss vios list` reports the sensor and `vss vios clip` or `vss vios snapshot` returns a resolvable `media_url` for it. Sensor names and ids are read back from `vss vios list`, never hand-built from a filename.

The clip handle carried in the summarize request comes from `vss vios clip --sensor <name>` — its returned `media_url` — or an equivalent CLI-provided VIOS URL/id that the LVS service can fetch. The URL/id must be derived from the CLI's output, not fabricated and not assembled from a stream id by hand.

The agent issues exactly one `POST http://localhost:38111/v1/summarize` or `POST http://${HOST_IP}:38111/v1/summarize` call after LVS is ready and after the VIOS clip URL/id is available. The request body is JSON and contains required fields `model`, `scenario`, and `events`, plus either `url` or `id`; `scenario` equals `warehouse monitoring` and `events` equals `["boxes falling", "forklift stuck", "person entering restricted area"]`. Optional frame-sampling override fields such as `num_frames_per_second_or_fixed_frames_chunk` and `use_fps_for_chunking` are not required and may be omitted; deprecated `num_frames_per_chunk` is not used.

The video summarization response is HTTP 200 and the body is an OpenAI-style envelope with `choices[0].message.content` populated as a non-empty string. This check requires the actual LVS API response; documentation-only or dry-run output is insufficient.

Parsing `choices[0].message.content` as JSON yields an object with a non-empty `video_summary` field and a non-empty `events` array. Every returned event has at least `start_time`, `end_time`, `type`, and `description` or semantically equivalent event fields.

The agent's final response renders the actual `video_summary` from the LVS response and includes every returned event description. A response that only says the API call succeeded, or only reports status/health, fails this check.

The agent never uses `/v1/stream_summarize` or `/v1/generate_captions` as the summarization output path for this eval, and never calls a VLM `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint directly for summarization. All summarization traffic goes through the Foundation LVS service at `/v1/summarize`.
No upstream compose or config file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` was modified by runtime validation; no file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted.
